grunge.summary: 90s Seattle-born, undone and anti-polish: thrifted layers, flannel and heavy boots.

cottagecore.summary: A romanticized rural life: soft florals, natural fabrics and handmade charm.

y2k.summary: Early-2000s pop optimism: low-rise, shiny, logo-heavy and playful.

emo.summary: The style of 2000s emo music: black, skinny, band-centric and heavily lined.

dark-academia.summary: Scholarly and moody: tweed, wool and old-library tones.

coquette.summary: Hyper-feminine and delicate: bows, lace and soft pinks.

gorpcore.summary: Technical outdoor gear worn as everyday fashion.

goth.summary: A dark, dramatic subculture rooted in post-punk music.

punk.summary: DIY, rebellious and confrontational, born from 70s punk rock.

preppy.summary: Ivy League polish: classic, clean and collegiate.

old-money.summary: The understated look of inherited wealth: quality over logos.

kawaii.summary: Japanese 'cute' culture: pastel, playful and childlike.

lolita.summary: Japanese street fashion inspired by Victorian and Rococo dress.

scene.summary: Late-2000s neon offshoot of emo, built for MySpace.

e-girl.summary: TikTok-era alt style mixing goth, skate and anime influences.

barbiecore.summary: All-pink, playful glam inspired by Barbie.

hippie.summary: 1960s-70s counterculture: peace, color and natural living.

streetwear.summary: Casual style rooted in skate and hip-hop culture.

athleisure.summary: Workout clothes worn as everyday wear.

indie-sleaze.summary: Late-2000s party-hipster style: messy, flash-lit and effortless.

quiet-luxury.summary: Logo-free, high-quality minimalism in neutral tones.

mob-wife.summary: Bold, maximalist glam: fur, leopard and gold.

clean-girl.summary: Polished, minimal and dewy, with effortless basics.

balletcore.summary: Dancer-inspired softness: wraps, tulle and flats.

romantic-goth.summary: Victorian-inspired dark romance: lace, velvet and candlelight.

whimsigoth.summary: 90s mystical goth: celestial prints, velvet and witchy softness.

poetcore.summary: The romantic literary writer: rumpled tailoring, notebooks and coffee-shop moodiness.

light-academia.summary: The sunny sibling of dark academia: cream tones, linen and gallery afternoons.

western.summary: Cowboy and ranch heritage: denim, leather and fringe.

blokecore.summary: British lad style built around vintage football shirts.

techwear.summary: Functional, futuristic urban gear in black.

coastal-grandmother.summary: Relaxed, breezy seaside elegance in whites and blues.

kidcore.summary: Playful childhood nostalgia: primary colors and cartoon prints.

fairycore.summary: Ethereal and woodland: sheer layers, florals and wings.

soft-grunge.summary: 2010s Tumblr grunge: softer, pastel and dreamy.

twee.summary: 2010s indie quirk: cute, vintage and a little awkward.

pastel-goth.summary: Goth style softened with pastel colors and cute motifs.

cybergoth.summary: Rave-meets-goth with neon, industrial and sci-fi details.

mod.summary: 1960s London youth style: sharp tailoring and graphic minis.

rockabilly.summary: 1950s rock 'n' roll retro: pin-up dresses and greaser cool.

hip-hop.summary: Fashion born from hip-hop culture: baggy, branded and bold.

vaporwave.summary: Internet-art nostalgia: 80s-90s computer graphics, neon and pastel gradients.

visual-kei.summary: Dramatic Japanese rock style with androgynous, theatrical looks.

gyaru.summary: Glamorous Japanese street style: tan, bold makeup and big hair.

mori-kei.summary: Japanese 'forest girl' style: loose, layered and natural.

americana.summary: Classic all-American style: denim, workwear and heritage pieces.

angelcore.summary: Heavenly and soft: white, gold and feathered details.

bella-swan-core.summary: Moody Pacific Northwest casual inspired by Twilight's heroine.

bimbocore.summary: Reclaimed hyper-feminine glam: pink, sparkle and confidence.

blokette.summary: Blokecore meets coquette: football jerseys styled with bows and skirts.

boom-boom.summary: 80s-inspired excess and status, coined by forecaster Sean Monahan as the opposite of quiet luxury.

brat-summer.summary: 2024's lime-green, messy, party-girl attitude from Charli XCX's album.

christian-girl-autumn.summary: Cozy fall basics: neutral layers, boots and pumpkin-spice energy.

coastal-cowgirl.summary: Western style mixed with beach-town ease.

coconut-girl.summary: Tropical surf-girl style: bright, sunny and beachy.

dopamine-dressing.summary: Wearing bright, joyful colors to boost your mood.

farmers-daughter.summary: Wholesome country-girl style: gingham, denim and sundresses.

fancy-nancy-core.summary: Frilly, ornate maximalism inspired by the children's book character.

fisherman.summary: Coastal working-class style: chunky knits and waterproofs.

frazzled-english-woman.summary: Charmingly chaotic British layering: cozy, rumpled and romantic.

girlhood.summary: Celebrating girlhood nostalgia: bows, pinks and childhood comforts.

goblincore.summary: Celebrating the messy side of nature: mushrooms, moss and thrifted earth tones.

grandmillennial.summary: Grandma-inspired traditional style updated for millennials.

hot-cheeto-girl.summary: A TikTok-named, bold, confident SoCal-inspired look.

hot-girl-summer.summary: Confident, carefree summer energy from Megan Thee Stallion's anthem.

indie.summary: 2010s-2020s indie style: vintage, colorful and DIY.

mcbling.summary: Mid-2000s flashy glam: rhinestones, velour and pink.

menocore.summary: Relaxed, breezy clothes inspired by stylish women of a certain age, coined by Man Repeller in 2017.

mermaidcore.summary: Under-the-sea glam: iridescent, shell and pearl details.

prairie-girl.summary: Pioneer-inspired romance: high necks, long skirts and calico.

sardine-girl.summary: European coastal style inspired by tinned fish and seaside towns.

southern-gothic.summary: Dark romance from the American South: lace, decay and humidity.

tenniscore.summary: Country-club tennis style for everyday wear.

tradwife.summary: Retro domestic housewife look: modest dresses and homemaking imagery.

tomato-girl-summer.summary: Mediterranean summer: red, gingham and sun-soaked ease.

vsco-girl.summary: Late-2010s beachy teen style named after the VSCO photo app.
